An initial mixed-backend racecheck run stalled in the second producer's Torch stream synchronization before registration import; terminated, not a pass. Torch-only control passed. Final sanitizer runner uses a fresh producer per backend; both complete cleanly. Ordinary GPU tests retain mixed-backend transitions.
IPC initcheck checks shared memory only; the driver-only hash probes check global and shared.
The attempted Blackwell GPT2-Large A/B could not load its absent offline cache and produced no timings. Laptop GPT2-Large and full Blackwell Qwen are measured.
